title: 4. Valid Parentheses (Stack LIFO)
description:
Given a string `s` containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid.

An input string is valid if:
1. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets.
2. Open brackets must be closed in the correct order.
3. Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type.
constraints:
• 1 <= len(s) <= 10^4
• `s` consists of parentheses only '()[]{}'.
• Optimal Time: O(N) | Optimal Space: O(N)
explanation: A stack enforces Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) hierarchical matching. Opening brackets are pushed. For each closing bracket, the top of the stack must match its pair. The string is valid if and only if the stack is completely empty at the end.
